research_use: pilot validation only; excluded from main results
review_design: same-reviewer masked row-level pass 1 and delayed reshuffled pass 2
interpretation: Exact source evidence separated C1 and C2 from C0 in this pilot, but C2 did not outperform C1 on semantic component preservation. The one C1 modal mismatch was a structured normative_type label mismatch while the Korean explanation preserved the communication capability meaning.
limitations: The reviewer had prior exposure to aggregate condition results and one identified C1 mismatch before row-level scoring.
This is intra-rater agreement, not independent human inter-rater reliability.
The 18-case pilot is too small and too easy to support inferential claims about C2 versus C1.
